summary_zh: 实际执行晚于心跳标记；原预计时间已过、next_run已推进，但最近run未变。只证明调度与run需补证，不证明漏跑或业务入口原因。
summary_en: Execution is later than the trigger timestamp; the prior expected time passed and next_run advanced, while the latest run is unchanged. Scheduler/run reconciliation is needed; this alone proves neither a missed trigger nor the business-entry cause.
